protocol.description:
Internal protocol that relays org.freedesktop.ScreenSaver inhibit/uninhibit requests between treeland and a per-user-session helper, because a multi-user compositor does not host per-user-session D-Bus itself.
The key words "must", "must not", "required", "shall", "shall not", "should", "should not", "recommended", "may", and "optional" in this document are to be interpreted as described in RFC 2119.
Warning! This protocol is EXPERIMENTAL and under active development. It may change at any time, including in backward-incompatible ways, without incrementing the interface major version and without prior notice. No compatibility guarantees of any kind are provided. Clients and compositors must track the upstream definition in treeland-protocols and must not rely on the current interface names, requests, events, or semantics remaining stable across releases.

interface.name: treeland_screensaver_v2
interface.description:
This interface is an internal relay between treeland and a privileged helper that implements the org.freedesktop.ScreenSaver D-Bus interface. Treeland is a multi-user compositor and does not host per-user-session D-Bus itself, so the org.freedesktop.ScreenSaver Inhibit/UnInhibit calls are forwarded over this Wayland protocol to a helper running in the user session, which then performs the actual idle-inhibit bookkeeping.
Only that dedicated relay helper should bind this global. Regular applications must NOT use this protocol to inhibit idleness; they should use the upstream zwp_idle_inhibit_manager_v1 protocol instead, which treeland exposes for normal clients.
The relay helper calls inhibit to register an inhibit on behalf of a D-Bus caller and uninhibit (or disconnects the bound object) to release it. If the bound object is destroyed, the inhibit associated with it is automatically released. At most one inhibit is active per bound object at a time; calling inhibit while an inhibit is already active raises already_inhibited, and calling uninhibit with no active inhibit raises not_yet_inhibited. Call uninhibit before inhibit to update application_name and reason.

entry.name: not_yet_inhibited
entry.summary: Trying to uninhibit but no active inhibit existed

entry.name: already_inhibited
entry.summary: Trying to inhibit with an active inhibit existed

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the bound treeland_screensaver_v2 object. Any inhibit previously registered through this object is released as if uninhibit had been called, and the relay helper must stop holding the corresponding org.freedesktop.ScreenSaver inhibit on the D-Bus caller's behalf.

request.name: inhibit
request.description: Inhibit idleness with given application_name and reason_for_inhibit.

arg.name: application_name
arg.summary: name of the application requesting the inhibit

arg.name: reason_for_inhibit
arg.summary: human-readable reason for the inhibit request

request.name: uninhibit
request.description: Uninhibit idleness previously inhibited by inhibit request.
